scenes.say: First practice in Vegas: an hour of rain and not a single timed lap.
Everyone ran full wet tyres. The fastest car through the speed trap managed just one hundred and ninety.
By the evening the rain had stopped, but the track was still wet. Norris was the first onto intermediates.
Russell set the best lap, almost fourteen seconds slower than dry practice a year ago.
Gasly was seven hundredths behind, Leclerc a third of a second. Verstappen was only thirteenth.
Thirty-three laps were deleted, most of them for track limits at Turn Eight.
All of these laps and tyres are on our LapRadar live map.

title: Wet Thursday in Vegas: both practice sessions in LapRadar numbers
